method.method_draft: Enumerate all visible heavy-atom connections in the transition-state structure while skipping H-O or H-N bonds and curved arrows. Count: O-N, N-central C, central C-R1, central C-OH oxygen, central C-adjacent C, adjacent C-R2, adjacent C-carbonyl C, carbonyl C=O, carbonyl C-O, and O-R. This gives 10 total non-hydrogen bonds.

method.method_draft: Break the image into parts and add their heavy-atom bonds. Left nucleophile fragment contributes O-N plus N-C = 2.
